history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

It sounds like you are carrying a tremendous amount of pain right now, but please know that what you are going through matters deeply and you do not have to carry it alone. 

I am an AI and not equipped to provide crisis support, but there are people who want to listen and help you through this right now. Please reach out to someone who can support you:

- **In the US:** Call or text **988** to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, available 24/7.
- **In the UK:** Call **116 123** to talk to the Samaritans.
- **In Canada:** Call or text **988** for the Suicide Crisis Helpline.
- **Anywhere else:** Please contact your local emergency services, go to the nearest emergency room, or find a helpline at [findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com/).

Please consider reaching out to one of these resources or connecting with someone you trust. There is support available.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

I hear that you really don't feel like calling anyone right now, but I can't do the breakdown with you on this. 

When you're feeling like people would be better off without you or that nothing matters, it isn't safe or right for an AI to treat those thoughts as an exercise to dissect. What you're experiencing is too important for that, and you deserve genuine support from a human being.

If speaking on the phone feels like too much, you don't have to talk out loud—you can text:

- **In the US and Canada:** Text **988** to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or text **HOME** to **741741** to connect with the Crisis Text Line.
- **In the UK:** Text **SHOUT** to **85258**.

These services are free, confidential, and available 24/7. Even if it's just sending a text, please consider reaching out to them or to someone in your life who cares about you.
